In 2015, Sanon starred in the successful romantic action comedy "Dilwale".

title: Raabta (song)

"Raabta" (English: Relation) is a romantic Hindi song from the 2012 Bollywood film, "Agent Vinod". Composed by Pritam Chakraborty, the song is sung by Arijit Singh, with lyrics penned by Amitabh Bhattacharya.
